title: Mornington Wednesday Market (Main Street Market)
summary: Mornington's long-running artisan market fills Main Street every Wednesday, 9am to 3pm. Expect local makers, produce and food; severe weather can cancel the market or limit stalls.
recurrenceNote: Weekly – every Wednesday year-round (weather and wind policy dependent)
accessibilityNotes: Street market; footpaths; generally accessible; some uneven sections
weatherDependency: Outdoor; high winds or heat may limit stalls, and a severe weather warning can cancel the market.
provenance: Main Street Mornington's organiser page checked on 2026-10-03. It states every Wednesday, 09:00 to 15:00, and explains high-wind, severe-weather and heat policies. The prior 14:00 closing time and blanket rain-or-shine statement were incorrect. The old 103 Main Street address describes the chamber office, not the full street market.
nearbyAttractions: Mornington foreshore; Mornington Regional Gallery; local cafes
suggestedItineraryPairing: Wednesday market + gallery visit + beachside lunch
editorVerdict: Forty years of Wednesdays on Main Street. Not a tourist event, just the way Mornington shops midweek.
editorNote:
An artisan street market on Main Street each Wednesday, 9am to 3pm. The organiser may limit stalls in high wind or heat and cancel for a severe weather warning. Check its current notice before travelling.

The move: combine the market with a Main Street cafe and a foreshore walk.
